name: @jmc-gtm/claude-offer-stack
description: Offer stack and pain quantification: every component removes a pain the buyer has put a number on. Prints each pain's yearly cost as a sum the buyer can check, and refuses filler lines, open pains, satisfaction-only guarantees and a price bigger than the pain. Stdlib-only Python scorer. No network.
author: JMC Go-to-Market Systems
